containment_time_pairing.rule: A containment-time delta is included only when both the candidate and do-nothing baseline achieved containment and both times are numeric.
Containment-time deltas require both candidate and scripted defense to achieve containment.

interpretation.raw_deltas: candidate minus scripted defense; inspect each metric independently
